strings.name: Max Levchin
strings.role: Software engineer · Payments and fintech entrepreneur
strings.summary: Born in Kyiv, Levchin moved to the United States as a teenager and studied computer science at Illinois. He co-founded Confinity and helped build PayPal, leading early technology and risk-prevention work. He later led Slide and founded Affirm, applying software and data analysis to consumer installment credit, alongside investing and board service.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 16 November 2026; not a live news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Co-founding PayPal and founding Affirm advanced online payments, fraud prevention and consumer finance platforms.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birthplace
strings.facts.f1.value: Kyiv, Ukraine; moved to the United States in 1991.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Computer science bachelor's degree, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign (1997).
strings.highlights.h1.title: PayPal's early technology
strings.highlights.h1.text: Helped build online payments as co-founder and chief technology officer.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Founding Affirm
strings.highlights.h2.text: Applied data and software to merchant payments and consumer installment credit.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Joining Coca-Cola's board
strings.timeline.t1.text: Elected a director, bringing technology and payments experience to governance.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Affirm lists on Nasdaq
strings.timeline.t2.text: The fintech company he led became publicly traded under AFRM.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Founding Affirm
strings.timeline.t3.text: Developed consumer and merchant payment finance through his innovation lab HVF.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Google acquires Slide
strings.timeline.t4.text: The media-sharing service was sold to Google, where he joined engineering management.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becoming Slide CEO
strings.timeline.t5.text: Began leading social applications and personal media-sharing services.
strings.timeline.t6.title: PayPal sold to eBay
strings.timeline.t6.text: The payments company where he was CTO was acquired by eBay.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Co-founding Confinity
strings.timeline.t7.text: Established the company with partners; it later merged with X.com and became PayPal.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completing computer science studies
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earned his Illinois degree and continued technology entrepreneurship.
